'''Revelation Ralltiir Operations 2''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 17 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 ROps Revelation DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Tons more Imps, many improvements.

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

The More Coming Soon: Deploy the biker scouts from reserve deck, reinforce them and flip. Then drain out your opponent, forfeiting Vaders and Maras if he fights you, then replacing them. Pull cards from your reserve deck for beatdowns.You Are Beaten+Dark Strike=kills. bigchief: Ahem...using Blaster Rack I get a saber on Mara Jade. I don't have more Mauls, or else I would use them (duh). As for my strategy section, I said MORE WAS COMING SOON!!!
